title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 26
description: Ten questions on Numbers 26: the second census in the plains of Moab, the families of each tribe, the dividing of the land and the Levites.

questions.text: From what age were the men counted in this census?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told them to take a census of the congregation from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go to war.

questions.text: Where did Moses and Eleazar the priest count the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: Those counted were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

answers.text: In the wilderness of Sinai by the mountain
At Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin
On the top of Mount Hor near Edom
In the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho

questions.text: What does the chapter say about the sons of Korah?
questions.explanation: After describing how the earth swallowed up Korah's company, the text says, "Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn't die."

answers.text: They were all swallowed by the earth
They were burned with the two hundred fifty men
They were driven out of Israel

questions.text: Which of these was one of the daughters of Zelophehad?
questions.explanation: The daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah.

questions.text: In which tribe's list is a daughter named Serah mentioned?
questions.explanation: In the list of the sons of Asher the text says, "The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah."

questions.text: What was the total number counted of the children of Israel?
questions.explanation: "These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty."

answers.text: Five hundred ninety-one thousand two hundred
Six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty
Six hundred twenty thousand five hundred
Seven hundred one thousand four hundred thirty

questions.text: How was the land to be divided among the tribes?
questions.explanation: The larger groups would get more and the smaller less, but the land was to be divided by lot, according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.

answers.text: By lot, more to the larger and less to the smaller
Equally to every tribe, whatever its size
By the choice of each prince
According to the age of each tribe's father

questions.text: What was the name of Amram's wife?
questions.explanation: Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, and she bore to Amram Aaron, Moses and Miriam their sister.

questions.text: When did Nadab and Abihu die?
questions.explanation: "Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before Yahweh."

answers.text: When they were bitten by snakes
When they were swallowed by the earth
When they died of the plague at Peor
When they offered strange fire before Yahweh

questions.text: Who were the only men left of those counted by Moses and Aaron in the wilderness of Sinai?
questions.explanation: Yahweh had said they would die in the wilderness, and not a man was left of them except Caleb the son of Jephunneh and Joshua the son of Nun.
